gloss: even a little; as much as possible

definitions.explanation: Emphasizes that even a small amount or degree is significant. Often used in conditional or hypothetical contexts.

definitions.gloss: as much as possible; to whatever extent one can
definitions.explanation: Expresses the desire to maximize something, even if only by a small amount. Common with verbs of effort or improvement.

examples.japanese: {少|すこ}しでも⟦{気|き}になったら→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: If you're even a little curious, just ask.

examples.japanese: {少|すこ}しでも⟦{異変|いへん}→異変：15754_ihen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じたら→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you feel even the slightest abnormality, please go to the hospital immediately.

examples.japanese: {少|すこ}しでも⟦{遅|おく}れたら→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わない→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: If we're even a little late, we won't make it in time.

examples.japanese: {少|すこ}しでも⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{買|か}いたい→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I want to buy it as cheaply as possible.

examples.japanese: {少|すこ}しでも⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}てれば→立てる：01196_tateru⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧です。
examples.english: I'd be happy if I could be of even a little help.

examples.japanese: {少|すこ}しでも⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{速達|そくたつ}→速達：04393_sokutatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I sent it by express mail so it would arrive as quickly as possible.

notes:
A very common adverbial phrase combining ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧ (a little) + ⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧ (even). The ⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧ particle adds emphasis, turning 'a little' into 'even a little.' Sense 1 is used in conditional contexts ('if even a little...'), while sense 2 expresses a desire to maximize something ('as X as possible').

USAGE:
Sense 1 typically pairs with conditional forms (〜たら、〜なら、〜ば). Sense 2 appears with desiderative forms (〜たい) or expressions of effort.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ — even a bit; more casual version of the same idea
- ⟦{多少|たしょう}→多少：01647_tashou⟧なりとも — to any extent, however slight; more formal
- ⟦できるだけ→できるだけ：01289_dekirudake⟧ — as much as possible; focuses on effort rather than degree
